items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Miss Alice Zeno. Alice William Zeno. Alice William Zeno. Who is this? [INTERVIEWEE] That's Hall. Edmund Hall.

ctx.x: She sure is. What's your name, James? What's your name? Miss Alice Zeno. Alice William Zeno. Alice William Zeno. Who is this?
